faqs.q: What is the price of Macadamia Nuts (म्याकाडामिया नट्स) in Nepal?
faqs.a: NaturesMud Shelled Macadamia Nuts (200 GM Pack) costs Rs. 1,100 in Nepal (Rs. 550 per 100g of 100% edible kernel). We deliver across Kathmandu Valley and nationwide.

faqs.q: Are these Macadamia Nuts already shelled or in the hard shell?
faqs.a: They are 100% shelled, ready-to-eat whole and half kernels—so you get 200 GM of pure edible nut without paying for heavy shell weight or struggling to crack them.

faqs.q: How many Macadamia Nuts should I eat per day?
faqs.a: Because macadamias are rich and calorie-dense, 5 to 8 kernels (about 15g–20g) per day is an ideal serving.

faqs.q: Do Macadamia Nuts grow in Nepal?
faqs.a: Yes! Macadamia trees thrive in Nepal’s mid-hill districts such as Palpa, Syangja, Kavre, and Dhading between 900m and 1,500m altitude.

faqs.q: How should I store shelled Macadamia Nuts?
faqs.a: Seal tightly after each use and store in a cool cupboard or inside the refrigerator to keep their buttery oils fresh.
